statement:
(∀ t : ℝ, ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g →
 KdVPlan.HB 1 (KdVPlan.J t f g) (12 * (1 + KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹))*KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g)) ∧
 (∀ t : ℝ, ∀ A g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 (KdVPlan.invD A) → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g →
 KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.J t A g) (KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.invD A)*KdVPlan.hn 0 g))
proof:
have sp : ∀ s t : ℝ, ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.HB s (KdVPlan.S (-t) (KdVPlan.P f)) (KdVPlan.hn s f) := by
 intro s t f hf
 have Hp := (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).1 s 0 f hf |>.2.2
 have HS := (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).1 s (-t) (KdVPlan.P f) Hp.1
 exact ⟨HS.1, HS.2.1.trans_le Hp.2⟩
constructor
· intro t f g hf hg
  have Hif := (yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_T013 f hf).1
  have Hig := (yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_T013 g hg).1
  have Hsf := (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).1 1 t (KdVPlan.invD f) Hif.1
  have Hsg := (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).1 1 t (KdVPlan.invD g) Hig.1
  have Hm := yui_aux_0016 T gamma R h_T013 _ _ Hsf.1 Hsg.1
  have Hout := sp 1 t _ Hm.1
  refine ⟨Hout.1, Hout.2.trans (Hm.2.trans ?_)⟩
  rw [Hsf.2.1, Hsg.2.1]
  let E := 1 + KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹)
  have hE : 0 ≤ 3*E := by dsimp [E, KdVPlan.hn]; positivity
  calc
   3*E*KdVPlan.hn 1 (KdVPlan.invD f)*KdVPlan.hn 1 (KdVPlan.invD g) ≤ 3*E*(2*KdVPlan.hn 0 f)*(2*KdVPlan.hn 0 g) :=
    mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left Hif.2 hE) Hig.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by dsimp [KdVPlan.hn]; positivity)
   _ = 12*E*KdVPlan.hn 0 f*KdVPlan.hn 0 g := by ring
· intro t A g hIA hg
  have HIA := (yui_aux_0018 T gamma R h_T013).1 0 t (KdVPlan.invD A) hIA
  have HIg := yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_T013 g hg
  have hls : Summable (fun k => ‖KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD g) k‖) := by simpa only [yui_aux_0017 T gamma R h_T013] using HIg.2.1
  have Hm := yui_aux_0007 T gamma R h_T013 (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD g)) (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD A)) hls HIA.1
  rw [(yui_aux_0015 T gamma R h_T013).1 (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD g)) (KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD A))] at Hm
  have Hout := sp 0 t _ Hm.1
  refine ⟨Hout.1, Hout.2.trans (Hm.2.trans ?_)⟩
  simp only [yui_aux_0017 T gamma R h_T013, HIA.2.1]
  calc
   (∑' k, ‖KdVPlan.invD g k‖)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.invD A) ≤ (KdVPlan.hn 0 (fun k => (Complex.I*(k : ℂ))⁻¹)*KdVPlan.hn 0 g)*KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.invD A) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right HIg.2.2 (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
   _ = _ := by ring
